scoring_justification: Wavefunction ΔH is recomputed from raw η², α² using a conversion constant backed out from the paper's own published values; hidden defect-type labels allow verified floating-bonnd vs dangling-bond trend comparison. DOS gap is structural (gap detection). Summary is structural (extract range and cross-check).

hidden_assets.purpose: Hidden defect-type labels (floating-bond neighbours and dangling-bond atoms) and empirical conversion constant to compute ΔH from α²η².
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Table I (Phys. Rev. Lett. 63, 1491). Atom indices and ΔH values extracted directly.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Manual extraction from Table I; the conversion constant is the average ratio of ΔH to α²η² across floating-bond entries (~1455 G).
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are exact published values used as a reference; no synthetic labels are invented.

outputs.description: Electronic density of states of the relaxed W3 model, expected to show a band gap.

Wavefunction amplitudes, s/p components, and computed hyperfine splittings for atoms in defect environments. Delta_H is recomputed by the verifier from the other columns and the public physical constants.

schema.description: Plain text file with sentences summarizing the computed hyperfine splitting ranges for floating-bond neighbours and dangling bonds.

outputs.description: Text summary reporting the numeric range of hyperfine splittings for floating bonds and noting that dangling-bond splittings are smaller. The verifier checks the qualitative agreement and range consistency.

output_contract.notes: The agent must implement the tight-binding model and all relaxation/terminator procedures without relying on pre-provided reference outputs. The physical constants and model coordinates are publicly available.

steps.description: Check that the DOS exhibits a clear energy gap of at least 0.5 eV.

Recompute ΔH from η², α² using the hidden conversion constant; verify internal consistency and confirm floating-bond neighbours have large splittings (≥25 G), dangling-bond sites have small splittings (≤35 G), and fb_max > db_max.
Extract the reported floating-bond hyperfine range, check that it is sensible and consistent with the wavefunction data, and confirm that dangling bonds are described as smaller.
